modalLead: Restore an automatic backup in one click, plus a few small refinements to the automatic-backups panel.

items.text: Restore straight from the list — each automatic backup now has a Restore button next to Download and Delete. It replaces all current data with that backup (after a confirmation) and reloads — no need to download the ZIP and re-import it by hand.
Backup totals at a glance — the Automatic Backups section now shows a small summary line with how many backups you have and their combined size.
Back Up Now updates the last-backup date — creating a backup on demand now refreshes the Last backup label, just like the manual ZIP download does.

Two backups in the same moment no longer clash — making several backups within the same second now writes separate files instead of overwriting one, so nothing is lost when you click Back Up Now in quick succession.
